steps.title: Tuning
steps.text: The tune is the heart of the build. Pick the tuning platform you want to run: EZ LYNK or SCT / Bully Dog. Your tune is custom written for your truck and the parts you choose below. Add transmission tuning here if you want it.

options.name: EZ LYNK Custom Tuning Support Package
options.note: Limited is a 4-week support window. Full is longer support.

options.name: SCT / Bully Dog Custom Tuning
options.note: Needs your SCT or Bully Dog device. Pick your tune level.

steps.title: Delete Pipe
steps.text: The pipe that replaces the factory emissions section between the turbo and the exhaust.
